title: Price per square metre in Dushanbe: calculating and comparing
excerpt: Median asking prices per m² from the agency’s active apartment catalogue, the calculation method and why unlike properties should not be compared directly.
contentHtml:
Substantively checked and updated on 16 October 2026.

A price per square metre helps compare different apartment sizes but does not replace assessing the particular property. Divide the asking price by the stated area and compare like categories. The figures below describe only the agency’s active apartments on the snapshot date.

Method: published unsold apartments with positive price and area only; houses, commercial premises and land are excluded. Prices are seller offers, not completed transaction amounts. The median is the middle of sorted values, rounded to whole TJS. A small sample does not describe the whole market. Price and availability may change: open the listing and confirm current terms before deciding.

Check the inputs

Confirm the price and the area it covers. Compare the listing area with documents and the contents of the offer. Ask separately about compulsory extra payments. A down payment alone cannot produce a comparable price per square metre.

Snapshot example: listing №103, 1,555,680 TJS ÷ 105 m² = 14,816 TJS/m². This uses the stated asking price; it is not a transaction valuation.

How the district table is calculated

The asking price is divided by the area for each apartment with positive price and area values. The table shows the median of those individual ratios, rounded to whole TJS. This differs from dividing all prices combined by all areas combined. The apartment count indicates the sample size.

An equal price per metre does not mean an equal property

Compare condition, floor, building height, layout and included items. Clarify missing information before making a financial decision. A low price alone does not establish a title problem, while a high one does not prove construction quality or value. Ask the individual seller to explain differences.

Use it alongside a complete budget

After comparing per-metre figures, consider the full price, possible works and payment terms again. Record the date and listing references. The table is not a price forecast or evidence of yield. Open the catalogue for current offers because prices or availability may have changed since the snapshot.

faq.q: How do I calculate one apartment’s price per m²?
faq.a: Divide its full asking price by its stated area in square metres. Check that price and area refer to the same property and offer contents.

faq.q: Why does a median differ from an average?
faq.a: The median is the central value in a sorted series. An arithmetic average adds the values and divides by their count; extreme values affect it differently.
